original: Did we...did we do it? Did we make\nit back to our world?
What about Etemon? Where are the\nothers?
No doubt about it! We're near my\nplace! We're back in Japan!
Must be because of that distortion\nwe got sucked into! That must be \nwhy you devolved to Koromon!
We did it, we did it!
This is my house, Koromon! I\nwonder if Mom and Dad are okay...
(How long has it been since I went\nto the other world?)
(Maybe someone I've never met will\nopen the door.)
Why should I be surprised? I mean,\nit's just Koromon, right?
They left this morning to visit\nGrandma, since she's sick and all,\ndidn't they?
Did you go to Koromon's world?
So you didn't go to camp with the\nother kids after all...
Oh, right. Maybe the others came\nback too.
No one else is back. Are they\nstill on the other side?
This is the afternoon news for\nAugust 1. First, the daily report.
In terms of the abnormal weather,\nthere has still been no rain in\nSoutheast Asia...
Record-breaking rains in the\nMiddle East have caused flooding,\nNorth America is covered in snow.
Seadramon and Yukidarumon! This\nisn't just abnormal weather!
The distortion from the Digital\nWorld is affecting my world, too!
Now you can see them, Taichi? You\ntoo?
I've been able to see them for a\nlong time, but whenever I said\nanything, nobody believed me.
I'm at home! I came back to our\nworld! I'm with Koromon right now!
Hey, Koushirou! I can't hear you!
What's going on over there, and\nwhat's going on over here...?
Hey, Koromon. Is it okay for us to\njust stay here?
Yeah. I mean, we don't even know\nhow to get back to the other side.
Taichi doesn't have to go back,\nright? You can stay here now,\nright?
Both of you can stay here from now\non...
I mean, Koromon, if you stay at\nour place, you won't need to\nfight.
You can eat our food, you can eat\nsweets anytime you want.
It's summer vacation! We're on\nsummer vacation right now! We\nstill haven't gone to the beach...
We have to go see the fireworks,\ntoo! And I haven't done my\nhomework...
This thing dragged me over there.\nWho cares about it being a holy\ndevice, and all that!
Taichi, I'm going back to the\nothers.
I'm a Digimon, so I can't stay\nhere...
Don't say things like that,\nKoromon! Don't say you're\nleaving...
Hikari! I *told* you not to come!
Taichi! Get out of here, fast!
Don't go in by yourself! We've\nalways fought together, right?
Hikari, I'll be sure to come back.
I've got no choice. I have to go\nwith him...
Was this really the right thing to\ndo?
We'll be sure to return, once\nwe've done what we have to.
